chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: When the Pillars brothers joined
summary: Hayes Pillars joined in 1927 after Texas; his brother came later and played section parts.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, Charles Pillars, I didn't think Charles Pillars came in the band the same time his brother did. I thought he came in later.
Hayes wasn't with us at the Adolphus.
I know that, he wasn't with you in Texas at all. It wasn't until you came out of Texas.
Now his brother is a couple of years younger than he is; isn't he?
Yes, he's younger, but he joined us later.
His brother didn't play solo, his brother wasn't featured in the band?
Mostly section. He played fair, but nothing like Hayes Pillars.
